meta_description:
22K likes, 307 comments - sachintendulkar on October 29, 2026: "I had an idea for a shoe for fast bowlers that we could explore at @tenxyouworld. With @thevarunmayya, I used Astra to see how we could bring it to life.

What I enjoyed was being able to talk through the details, change things along the way and see the idea take shape as a 3D model.

It’s still a prototype, but quite something to see an idea in your head become something you can look at from every angle.

Fast bowlers, what would you add?

#partnership".
